head: 80a1975d93b80fc9953e418f25bf1069caaf7bae
claim: an app's poll after a key sign-in costs one setup detection instead of fifteen, and the model the picker offered from the provider's live catalog (MiniMax Flash) stays listed and pickable on the key lane

steps.start: The app has just signed in with a MiniMax API key: the engine holds the key and the provider's live catalog is registered.
steps: The app reads the member's providers after the sign-in (readiness)
The app reads the member's account list
The app checks whether the member is signed in to the key's provider
The app lists the key lane's models and picks the model the picker offered
steps.result: The reads after the sign-in cost one setup detection between them, and the key lane lists minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash and the pick takes it.

verdicts.seen: I read all three entries. The first shows pollRounds 3 and detections 1, matching one detection instead of fifteen. The second lists minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash in the lane and shows it as the pick, matching the model staying listed and pickable. The third shows detectionsAfterAccountChange 1, consistent with the outcome. The outcome names one part, so no parts are listed.
